hook: ChatGPT just dropped *GPT-6* and a whole new look
dek: OpenAI's new Intelligent UI turns chats into tappable charts and calculators.

slides.label: What Happened
slides.text: OpenAI is rolling out *Intelligent UI*, a new visual interface for ChatGPT, launching with GPT-6.

slides.label: How It Works
slides.text: Instead of plain text, ChatGPT will add *interactive* buttons, calculators, charts and editable graphs.

slides.label: The Goal
slides.text: OpenAI says the point is to make *learning complex topics* easier, not just chatting in text.

slides.label: Real Example
slides.text: A product manager asked ChatGPT how a plane wing generates lift, it instantly built *interactive diagrams*.

slides.label: More Examples
slides.text: Other demos included recipe visuals, bike mechanics diagrams, hiking maps and a *savings calculator*.

slides.label: Your Choice
slides.text: Don't want all the extra visuals? Users can *dial them back* anytime.

slides.label: Rollout Timeline
slides.text: Intelligent UI launches Wednesday for *Pro, Plus, Business and Enterprise* users, Thursday for Go and free tiers.

slides.label: Why It Matters
slides.text: A more visual, interactive AI could make complex info *more accessible* for learners who don't just absorb walls of text.

question: Rate this new visual ChatGPT 1 to 10.
first_comment: Fun fact: free and Go tier users get Intelligent UI a full day after Pro and Plus users, not the same day.

caption_instagram:
ChatGPT is getting a major visual upgrade with OpenAI's new Intelligent UI interface, rolling out alongside the GPT-6 model this week, according to TechCrunch.

Instead of just text, ChatGPT will now generate interactive buttons, custom calculators, editable graphs and tappable charts right inside your conversation. OpenAI says the goal is to make learning complex topics easier, whether that's a college student asking how an airplane wing generates lift or someone planning a multi-day hike.

The rollout starts Wednesday for Pro, Plus, Business and Enterprise users, then hits free and Go tier users Thursday. Not into all the extra visuals? You can dial them back anytime.

For creators, students and founders who learn best visually, not just by reading walls of text, this could shift how accessible AI tools really feel.

OpenAI is rolling out Intelligent UI, a new ChatGPT interface launching alongside GPT-6, according to TechCrunch. The update brings interactive elements, tappable buttons, editable graphs, custom calculators and charts, directly into conversations instead of plain text responses.

OpenAI's stated goal is making complex topics easier to learn, but the bigger story may be accessibility. A more visual, interactive interface lowers the barrier for users who don't want to parse dense text to get useful answers, whether that's a founder building a financial model or a student learning a new skill.

The rollout starts Wednesday for Pro, Plus, Business and Enterprise users, then expands Thursday to free and Go tier users. Visuals are customizable, so teams that prefer a lighter touch can scale them back.

For founders and operators building with AI tools daily, interface changes like this often signal where the bigger platform shift is headed next.
